name: Williams-Sonoma, Inc.
blurb: Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is an omni-channel specialty retailer of home products, including cookware, home furnishings, and decor, operating brands such as Williams Sonoma, Pottery Barn, West Elm, and Rejuvenation. Founded in 1956, the company has a strong direct-to-consumer and e-commerce presence, with a market cap of approximately $22 billion. It competes in the specialty retail sector, focusing on premium home goods and furniture.
recent: As of May 6, 2026, WSM closed at $186.47, up 3.44% on the day, with a 52-week range of $147.39–$222.00.
